terminal.welcome: Welcome. Type 'help' for commands, or just ask me a question.
terminal.help:
Available commands:
  ls              - list the sections
  cd <section>    - go to a section (cd skills)
  cat <section>   - read certs, education or experience
  ls projects     - list my projects
  open <project>  - open a project (Tab lists them)
  whoami          - who I am
  skills          - what I work with
  curl resume.pdf - download my resume
  git log --stats - pull live GitHub stats
  history         - what you've typed so far
  lang ar|en      - switch language
  playground      - games and experiments
  sudo hire-me    - you know you want to
  clear           - clear the terminal
  help            - show this message

Tab completes a command, ↑/↓ go through past ones.

Not a command? Just type a question - the AI guide
(bottom-right) opens and answers it.
